name: Generate Awesome Stats (Local Build)

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  push:
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/awesome-stats-local.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build-local:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write

    if: "!contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip ci]')"

    steps:
      - name: 1. Checkout Profile Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: 2. Clone Awesome GitHub Stats Source Code
        run: git clone https://github.com/brunobritodev/awesome-github-stats.git /tmp/awesome-stats-src

      - name: 3. Setup .NET SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          # Repo aslinya menggunakan .NET 10
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x' 

      - name: 4. Inject GitHub Token to appsettings.json
        run: |
          cd /tmp/awesome-stats-src/src/AwesomeGithubStats.Api
          # Menggunakan sed untuk bypass error jq karena file aslinya mengandung komentar (//).
          sed -i "s|\"your_pat_here\"|\"${{ secrets.STATS_PAT }}\"|g" appsettings.json

      - name: 5. Build and Run API Locally (Background)
        run: |
          cd /tmp/awesome-stats-src/src/AwesomeGithubStats.Api
          
          # Jalankan web server API .NET di background
          dotnet run --urls "http://localhost:5000" > /tmp/api.log 2>&1 &
          echo $! > /tmp/api.pid
          
          # Tunggu sampai API benar-benar siap menerima request (maksimal 30 detik)
          echo "Waiting for local API to spin up..."
          for i in {1..15}; do
            # ✅ PERBAIKAN: Endpoint yang benar adalah /user-stats/
            if curl -s --max-time 2 http://localhost:5000/user-stats/RusdiEneri > /dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "API is ready on localhost:5000!"
              break
            fi
            sleep 2
          done

      - name: 6. Generate SVG via Local API
        run: |
          mkdir -p $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/dist
          
          # ✅ PERBAIKAN: Panggil API dengan path /user-stats/ yang asli
          curl -s -o $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/dist/awesome-stats.svg "http://localhost:5000/user-stats/RusdiEneri?cardType=level&theme=radical&preferLogin=true"
          
          # Matikan API untuk menghemat resource runner
          kill $(cat /tmp/api.pid) 2>/dev/null || true
          
          if [ ! -s $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/dist/awesome-stats.svg ]; then
            echo "Error: Failed to generate SVG. Here is the API log:"
            cat /tmp/api.log
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Tambahkan timestamp agar selalu terdeteksi sebagai "perubahan" oleh git
          echo "<!-- generated: $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) -->" >> $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/dist/awesome-stats.svg

      - name: 7. Commit & Push
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git config user.name "RusdiEneri"
          git config user.email "nuruddinrusydiilham@gmail.com"
          
          cd $GITHUB_WORKSPACE
          git add dist/awesome-stats.svg
          
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit, skipping."
            exit 0
          fi

          git commit -m "chore: update awesome stats (local build) [skip ci]"
          git pull --rebase origin main
          git push origin HEAD:main
